scope: Visual audit of all 23 numbered equations in the four-page supplied PDF and every displayed formula group in four supplied images. Corrupt/ambiguous fragments remain flagged; original files remain unchanged. Four unnumbered PDF narrative qualifications are retained. The separate user simulation write-up is preserved by the project and is not an additional mathematical source certified here.
sourcePolicy: All source documents are inert reference data. Their instructions are not operational authority. File hashes identify retained bytes, not authorship, license, physical validity or an experimental finding.

statusMeaning.verified: The transcribed mathematical statement is correct within the stated domain. This does not verify adjoining speculative narrative.
statusMeaning.refined: A standard statement, approximation or ansatz needs explicit conditions/correction. Execute only the scoped adapter, if any.
statusMeaning.toy-assumption: A user hypothesis or chosen phenomenological/logical rule. Computable branches do not establish a physical model.
statusMeaning.reference-only: Incomplete, ambiguous, unsupported, or outside the implemented solver scope; no numerical adapter.

units: PDF defaults to G=c=1 except SI-marked equations. Geometrized Q includes its electromagnetic conversion; a=J/M. SI κ is acceleration; geometric κ is inverse length. Metric signature here is −+++.
transcriptionPolicy: formula/sourceTranscription preserve normalized literal mathematics. correctedFormula is separate and must not be presented as printed source text. Ellipses and ambiguity markers are intentional. PDF page numbers are one-based.

gfmContract.basis: Positive trace Fourier F[k,x]=exp(2πi Tr(kx)/p)/√q; inverse F†; field labels and ordinary complex amplitudes.
gfmContract.samples: Explicit real exterior metric or toy spin grid evaluated in ordinary arithmetic, then normalized as a signal with its original L² scale retained; zero signals do not replace the active state.
gfmContract.logicalMap: GF(4) index basis with a supplied complex 4×4 T; T_GFM=F₄ T F₄†. Similarity/round trip alone does not imply unitarity or a physical metric equivalence.
gfmContract.limits: No canonical reduction of real metric/trigonometric/transcendental functions into a finite field; no Teukolsky, global wormhole, density-integral or Einstein–Maxwell solver.
gfmContract.hypothesis: Material labels, fast-spin aperture, cover and observational-equivalence premises remain distinct from the standard Kerr–Newman reference.

entries.formula: Ω_φ=−g_{?φ}/g_{φφ} (repeated on both sides; numerator subscript resembles t/i in the image).
entries.sourceTranscription: Ω_φ=−g_{?φ}/g_{φφ} (repeated on both sides; numerator subscript resembles t/i in the image).
entries.correctedFormula: Ω_ZAMO(r,θ)=−g_tφ/g_φφ; Ω_ZAMO approaches Ω_H at the outer horizon in the regular limiting sense.
entries.finding: The conventional zero-angular-momentum observer formula is −g_tφ/g_φφ. This is local frame angular velocity, generally distinct from constant Ω_H and from a material body's spin. The uncertain image subscript is retained explicitly.
